# Content Shrimp

> A brand brain that learns your voice and turns it into ready-to-post content — social posts, scripts, remixes and memes — that actually sound like you, not generic AI.

## What is Content Shrimp?

Content Shrimp is a web app for founders, creators, and small brands who are tired of generic AI output. You paste your website once; it reads every page, researches your competitors and reviews, and fills out your brand profile. A few questions sharpen it, and it keeps learning from every post you approve, edit, or pass — so it sounds more like you every week instead of like a blank ChatGPT starting from zero.

## Key Features

- Brand Brain: learns your voice across many dimensions — tone, pain points, vocabulary, words to avoid, CTA style, audience, competitors, and what you approve, edit and pass
- Weekly Ideas and a 7-day content calendar mapped to your themes
- Quick Posts: one-tap, ready-to-film posts for today
- Remix: turn any creator's video into a post in your own voice
- Trends: rising niche topics + competitor moves, plus reverse-engineer any viral video into the brand's own version
- Memes and product / lifestyle images (bring your own Google Gemini key)
- What People Search: the real questions people and AI assistants ask about your niche
- Pipeline and teleprompter to film and post
- Film with the built-in teleprompter, then post it yourself
- Multi-brand support with separate voice, calendar and team per brand

## Content Formats Generated

- Short-form video scripts (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)
- Carousel posts
- Static image posts
- Statement graphics (bold text)
- Micro-content (10-15 second clips)
- Memes and product / lifestyle images

## Pricing

- Free trial: 7 days of Pro-level access, no card required (Agency has no trial)
- Pro: $24/month — 750 posts a month, every tool, learning brand brain
- Agency: $79/month — 2,500 posts a month, every tool, learning brand brain

## Target Audience

Founders, creators, solopreneurs, small DTC brands, and agencies who need to post consistently but have no time and no content team.

## Technical Details

- Web app, no install required; works on desktop and mobile browsers and installs as a PWA
- Content generation and live web research powered by Grok (xAI)
- Image generation via Google Gemini, using your own API key
- Supabase for authentication and data storage
